_note: Jev（TypeSafe AI）の問いとしきい値。問いは英語で書く（Jev の精度が最も高い言語）。問いの ID はモデルに送られないので、instructions と criteria だけで意味が通じるように書く。変えたら実データで判定を確かめてから採用する（docs/recipes.md）。トピックの選択肢は config/topics.json の description から作る。

tech_question.instructions: Is `item` mainly about software development or IT technology? `item.type` says what kind of content it is. The content may be written in Japanese.

true.definition: The main subject is software development or IT technology
includes: programming, software design, testing, code review
AI, machine learning and LLMs, including how to use AI tools for work
developer tools, editors, programming languages, libraries
IT products and services and their technical features

false.definition: The main subject is something other than software or IT technology
examples: politics or society without a technology focus
general business or investment talk without a technology focus
false.note: Mentioning a smartphone or app only as a tool in a non-technical story does not count

topic_question.instructions: Which technology topic best matches the main subject of `item`? `item.type` says what kind of content it is. The content may be written in Japanese. If it spans several topics, choose the one the content most wants to convey.
